item.title: ‘Great believer in democracy’ – PDP celebrates Obasanjo on his birthday
item.description: The Kabiru Turaki-led faction of the Peoples Democratic Congress, PDP, has described former president Olusegun Obasanjo as a great believer in democracy. This is contained in a statement on Thursday to celebrate Obasanjo on the occasion of his birthday. Recall that Obasanjo was the first Presidential candidate of the PDP since its inception in 1998, serving two terms under the platform till 2007. item.title: Key provisions in the new Electoral Act that you may not know
item.description: The Electoral Act 2026 has introduced sweeping changes to Nigeria’s electoral process, including new rules on party primaries, membership registers, and the role of courts in election disputes. On February 18, President Bola Tinubu signed the Electoral Act amendment bill into law after the national assembly passed it.
